assessment_summary: Group assignment: Utilising an online project management platform, groups are required to organise their work and develop a report relating to specific information systems (IS) project management issue or trend. Students will be provided a list of contemporary IS project management trends/issues in week 2. Each group must select one of these topics and submit their nominated topic for approval to the unit coordinator by week 4. No more than three groups may select the same issue/trend.
Project Guide: Individual conceptualisation of the nature of projects both formation and execution as a written individual submission.

Written exam. A final assessment that pulls together the concepts and implications of project development and management. This is focused on concepts as discussed in the lectures, not defintions. Importantly this builds on both lecture material and your group work.
Detailed information for each assessment can be found on Canvas.

items.label: Overview paragraph 1
items.text: Projects are a common way of managing organisational transformation and change, the development of new products and the implementation of Information Technology (IT) in business. Information Systems (IS) business analysts will work in projects and need an understanding of both project management and the project environment. This unit will introduce you to the end-to-end project management lifecycle as described in the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK). You will learn how to successfully manage projects from initiation through execution to completion. The focus of this unit will be on the management, execution, and coordination of project activities. To this end, you will learn hands-on project management techniques and gain first-hand experience with a modern online project management platform, including an introduction to agile project management methodologies.

items.label: Learning outcome 1
items.text: LO1. describe the key phases of the project management life cycle including the tools and methods used in each of those phases

items.label: Learning outcome 2
items.text: LO2. describe and explain the need for project management in the context of information systems (IS)

items.label: Learning outcome 3
items.text: LO3. recognise the key attributes of alternative IS project management methodologies including Agile methods

items.label: Learning outcome 4
items.text: LO4. analyse critically past Information Systems projects, explaining and justifying key themes that contributed to the success or failure of those projects

items.label: Learning outcome 5
items.text: LO5. set up and manage a project using an online project management platform

items.label: Learning outcome 6
items.text: LO6. describe and explain contemporary IS trends and issues that impact IS project management

items.label: Learning outcome 7
items.text: LO7. learn about design thinking and how to manage ideas in a team setting, both hard and soft skills.

items.label: Final exam n/a
